- [RARC.6.1.1] **An engine has no thread of its own** ([RARC.5.1]). Each
  call runs on the thread that makes it and finishes before it returns
  ([RARC.5.6.1]), and each engine writes its own stream. A deployment of many
  engines — one per tier, or one per source within a tier — drives each from
  whichever threads the integrator chooses.
